sourceSnapshot.sourceSummary: Son's descendants take the direct-child modes when alone; a direct son blocks them, while daughters leave the stated complement or residuary modes.

explicitConditions: The direct son blocks son's descendants.
At one normalized son's-descendant generation, males alone take residue and males with females divide at 2:1.
With one direct daughter, female-only son's descendants collectively complete 2/3 with 1/6; a male makes the group residuary.
With two or more direct daughters, female-only son's descendants receive nothing unless a qualifying male makes them residuary.
explicitExclusions: Unequal or deeper son's-descendant generations require generation-aware input and are not admitted.
explicitOutcome: The stated fixed, blocking, and residuary modes apply to the repository's one normalized son's-descendant generation.
